name: furry-ai-state
description: Display AI companion state illustrations in a VSCode sidebar webview.

furry-ai-state.enabled.title: Enable Furry AI State
furry-ai-state.enabled.description: Connect to the AI Companion MCP Runtime local IPC bridge.

furry-ai-state.ipcPath.title: AI Companion IPC Path
furry-ai-state.ipcPath.description: Optional IPC path. Empty uses the furry-companion-mcp platform default.

furry-ai-state.reconnectDelayMs.title: Reconnect Delay
furry-ai-state.reconnectDelayMs.description: Initial reconnect delay in milliseconds when the MCP runtime is not available.

furry-ai-state.webviewPosition.title: Webview Position
furry-ai-state.webviewPosition.description: Where to show the Furry AI State webview.
enumDescriptions: Show the webview in the Furry AI State sidebar view.
Show the webview in an editor tab.

furry-ai-state.customImages.title: Custom State Images
furry-ai-state.customImages.description: Optional local image paths keyed by agent state. Missing or unreadable files fall back to bundled images.

furry-ai-state.bundledImages.title: Bundled State Images
furry-ai-state.bundledImages.description: Optional bundled image file names keyed by agent state. Missing or unreadable bundled files fall back to the default bundled image for that state.
